Welcome to a brutal new frontier!

Conquer the Mortal Realms with these Warhammer Age of Sigmar Secret Lair cards. Each drop contains five cards (four of which are reskins) that will help you defeat Chaos once and for all—or embrace its power for your own purposes. These cards shine in any deck or collection, and will be monumental in leading your Grand Alliance to victory!

Contents:
• 1x Borderless Blind Obedience
• 1x Borderless Danitha Capashen, Paragon as “Neave Blacktalon”
• 1x Borderless Najeela, the Blade-Blossom as “Archaeon the Everchosen”
• 1x Borderless Scourge of the Throne as “Stardrake”
• 1x Borderless Loxodon Warhammer as “Ghal Maraz, the Great Shatterer”
